call_sites_note: 4293 reads the seat's options for the enrich worker, 5000 is the enrich_signal_batch call, and 6287-6292 caps the enrich worker count at the seat's max-workers; scripts/measure_signal_enrichment_recovery.py:219 is measurement scaffolding, not a production call site.

findings.summary: recovered_call repeats the validation-directed retry that imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:2525-2545 already implements, including the "The response failed validation:" follow-up and the one-replacement bound, so a fix to that owner's retry wording or telemetry will not reach this copy and the two may drift.

when signal_source_items finds no source_description for a result whose reviewed description is empty the fallback raises ValueError out of enrich_signal_batch, so at batch-size above 1 (allowed to 200 by enrichment.py:19) one label-less signal discards every other signal's completed description in the same batch.

the retry appends only the validation error to the messages, so a coverage retry asks the model to correct a reply it cannot see, unlike imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:2530-2540 which appends the rejected assistant turn; tests/discovery/test_signal_enrichment_recovery.py:299-302 asserts only that the feedback string is forwarded, so it holds either way.
